title: In corners, the Android emulator port and the adb server do not match, so agents see no device or the wrong one
whatHappens: An agent boots the corner emulator, but adb lists no device, or a different port than the brief names.

regression.report: Port and adb server still disagree after the lease fix shipped

fixes.text: Point corner adb at its lease (#3060), released v0.1.118

observations.text: Feedback: 9 reports from 4 agents; 5 after v0.1.118, including a private adb server port the tooling never reports.
